new_events.actor: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman
new_events.summary: Annual royal address paired continued de-escalation and diplomacy with a firm-response pledge, described Gulf security as indivisible, reaffirmed the Mecca Defense Alliance with Turkiye and Pakistan, supported Yemen's internationally recognized government, and rejected political or economic coercion through international waterways. This is policy signaling, not evidence of a new operational order.

A Dubai-to-Tel Aviv flydubai flight diverted safely to Tabuk after a serious cockpit security incident. Saudi authorities detained the suspected crew member. Motive and any state or organizational linkage remain unresolved; airline reporting cautioned against premature attribution.

existing_event_updates.summary: The UK prime minister said there were strong indications Iran played a part in the suspected Fairford incident. Iran denied involvement. Preserve as a UK government assessment under active investigation, not independently proved Iranian direction.

economic_energy_updates.summary: Reuters reported Brent November settled at $103.50 per barrel and WTI at $90.42; Brent gained about 14% in September. Goldman Sachs continued to estimate Gulf oil exports at 23.3 million bpd over the prior week, roughly the 2025 average, while refined-fuel exports remained constrained. Export recovery does not establish normalized Hormuz security or traffic.
